Visa_Route: Employer-sponsored MOHRE work permit; Green Visa (self-sponsored, 5 yr); Golden Visa (10 yr)
Salary_Threshold: No general salary floor on the standard permit. Green Visa needs AED 15,000/month (approx AED 180,000/yr).
Relevance_To_Profile: Strongest match. Deep institutional residential and commercial portfolios; leasing, pricing and asset strategy are live disciplines. No points test.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Get degree certificates attested (MEA India + UAE embassy) - this is the long pole and is needed for any offer. Refresh passport validity to 2+ yrs. Build a Gulf-format CV (photo, nationality, visa status).

Visa_Route: Employer-sponsored work permit, then medical, biometrics and QID residence permit on arrival
Salary_Threshold: No published general floor; set by employer and contract.
Relevance_To_Profile: Smaller and more state-linked than the UAE. Real depth at QIA, Qatari Diar and Barwa, but far fewer employers.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Same attestation pack as UAE (MEA + Qatar embassy). Police clearance certificate. Expect medical on arrival.

Visa_Route: Occupation Permit (Professional category) - combined work and residence permit
Salary_Threshold: MUR 50,000/month minimum basic salary for the Professional category - roughly USD 1,100/month. Harmonised across ALL sectors under Budget 2026-27, which merged the former ProPass and Expert Pass into one Professional category.
Relevance_To_Profile: Underrated for this profile. A major domicile for India-focused funds, and fund administration is an explicitly listed sector - his waterfall and distributions experience is directly on-market.
What_To_Prepare_Now: RESOLVED: the floor is MUR 50,000/month and it is low - this is one of the most accessible destinations on the list, not a marginal one. Target the fund administrators servicing India-focused funds (Apex, IQ-EQ, Ocorian, Intercontinental Trust). Note the Family Occupation Permit was abolished in the same budget.

Salary_Threshold: EUR 40,904 from 1 March 2026. CONFIRMED that the relevant finance occupations sit on the Critical Skills Occupation List - Financial Analysts (specialist qualifications), quantitative analysts, risk managers, chartered accountants and Fund Accountants (Qualified) are all eligible - so the lower threshold applies, not the EUR 68,911 off-list rate.
Relevance_To_Profile: Upgraded on verification. Europe's fund administration capital, English-speaking, and the finance occupations are confirmed on the critical-skills list. The EUR 40,904 bar is modest for this seniority, making Ireland materially more accessible than first assessed.
What_To_Prepare_Now: RESOLVED: finance occupations are on the list, so budget against EUR 40,904 rather than EUR 68,911. Get the degree recognised via NARIC Ireland. Match your target job title to a listed occupation as closely as possible - the exact title is what the permit is assessed against.

Visa_Route: Highly Skilled Migrant permit (employer must be an IND-recognised sponsor)
Salary_Threshold: EUR 5,942 gross/month for age 30 and above; EUR 4,357 for under 30 (from 1 January 2026).
Relevance_To_Profile: Real estate investment and pension-capital hub. Employer must already be a recognised sponsor, which narrows the field but speeds up those that are.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Filter target employers by IND recognised-sponsor status before applying - it is a public register. Apostille degree certificates.

Salary_Threshold: EUR 50,700 gross/year standard; EUR 45,934 for shortage occupations and recent graduates.
Relevance_To_Profile: Frankfurt is a real fund and banking centre, but German-language expectations are real outside global institutions.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Degree must be recognised in the ANABIN database - check yours before applying, as a non-listed degree blocks the route.

Salary_Threshold: EUR 65,652 from 3 March 2026; EUR 47,174 for shortage occupations.
Relevance_To_Profile: Disproportionately relevant: a leading domicile for real estate and private equity fund structures, and Fund Administrator is a listed skilled occupation. The waterfall and distributions experience is the product here.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Target the shortage-occupation threshold if fund administration qualifies - it is a EUR 18,000 difference. Note real estate investment does NOT earn residency here.

Visa_Route: Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) - Core Skills or Specialist Skills stream
Salary_Threshold: Core Skills: AUD 79,499/yr from 1 July 2026, and the occupation must be on the Core Skills Occupation List. Specialist Skills: AUD 146,717/yr, with NO occupation-list requirement.
Relevance_To_Profile: The Specialist Skills stream is the interesting one - at that salary the occupation list stops mattering, which suits a senior finance hire.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Check whether the target occupation is on the CSOL (456 occupations). If not, the Specialist Skills salary is the route. Skills assessment may be required depending on occupation.

Salary_Threshold: General median-wage requirement was removed in March 2025. Median wage is NZD 35.00/hr from 9 March 2026 and still governs partner-support and some settings.
Relevance_To_Profile: Smallest market on this list by some distance. Genuine but thin for institutional real assets.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Employer must already hold Immigration NZ accreditation - verify that before investing time. Need 2 years relevant experience or a level 4+ qualification.

Salary_Threshold: Financial services: SGD 6,200/month minimum, rising with age to SGD 11,800 at 45+. Rises to SGD 6,600 from 1 January 2027. Must also score 40 points on COMPASS. Exempt from COMPASS above SGD 22,500/month.
Relevance_To_Profile: Asia's REIT capital and an excellent professional fit - but the visa is the constraint, not the market. COMPASS scores employer-side diversity and local-hiring ratios, so sponsorship willingness varies sharply by firm.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Target large institutions with established sponsorship track records. Ask about COMPASS score early in any process - a firm that cannot clear 40 points cannot hire you regardless of fit.

Salary_Threshold: GBP 38,700/yr general; GBP 41,500 for RQF 6+ roles from 8 April 2026, or the occupation going rate (50th ASHE percentile), whichever is higher.
Relevance_To_Profile: Deep market, but the most expensive and most restrictive route here. The Immigration Salary List is being phased out entirely by 31 December 2026.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Only pursue via employers with an existing sponsor licence and budget for it - sponsorship costs are substantial and rising. New payroll-period compliance rules took effect March 2026.

Salary_Threshold: Points-based: 100 points required, awarded automatically if the exact job title appears on the Critical Skills List. Finance and accounting professions are included.
Relevance_To_Profile: Real REIT and property-fund market (Growthpoint, Redefine, Hyprop), but the administrative burden is the highest on this list.
What_To_Prepare_Now: Two blocking prerequisites: SAQA validation of foreign qualifications, and registration with a South African professional body (IOBSA for finance). Both take months - start now if this is of interest. Standard processing runs 6-12 months; the Trusted Employer Scheme can compress that to 2-4 weeks.
